wreck.title: Abandoned wreck
wreck.description: You come across a drifting wreck. A few recoverable credits.

stowaway.title: Stowaway
stowaway.description: Someone snuck into your cargo hold. They pay their fare without a fuss.

distress.title: Distress signal
distress.description: You answer a distress call. The stranded ship is grateful.

shortcut.title: Secret route
shortcut.description: You know a shortcut. -1 fuel on this trip.

smugglerFriend.title: Smuggler friend
smugglerFriend.description: A smuggler friend crosses your path and leaves you some supplies.

tradeData.title: Trade data
tradeData.description: You intercept market price data. Useful.

engineFailure.title: Engine failure
engineFailure.description: Your engine sputters. Emergency repair. -fuel and -ship HP.

ionStorm.title: Ion storm
ionStorm.description: An ion storm damages the systems.

wrongTurn.title: Wrong turn
wrongTurn.description: You got lost in an asteroid field. Lost time.
wrongTurn.message: +1 day lost in the asteroid field.

cargoHit.title: Cargo damaged
cargoHit.description: A meteorite impact damages the cargo hold.

pirateAttack.title: Pirate attack
pirateAttack.description: A pirate ship emerges from the asteroid field. It's aiming for your engines.

bountyHunter.title: Bounty hunter
bountyHunter.description: Your negative reputation attracts a bounty hunter.

pirateIntimidated.title: Pirates intimidated
pirateIntimidated.description: Pirates approach... and recognize your ship. They turn back.

cursedSuffix: But the curse turns it around.
cursedMessage: ☠ Cursed — your good fortune turns against you.
